# EsomaKe

> > EsomaKe is Kenya's comprehensive online learning platform offering curriculum-aligned educational resources for primary and secondary schools, covering CBC and 8-4-4 systems with notes, revision questions, and interactive classroom tools.

EsomaKe serves Kenyan students across all education levels with subject-specific notes, practice questions, and answers aligned to the national curriculum. The platform covers core subjects including Mathematics, Sciences, Kiswahili, Religious Education, Business Studies, and Social Studies, with specialized support for KCPE and KCSE exam preparation.

## Key Topics

- Kenyan Curriculum (CBC and 8-4-4)
- Secondary School Education (Forms 1-4)
- Primary School Learning (Classes 6-8)
- Revision Questions and Practice Quizzes
- Kiswahili and Fasihi Simulizi
- Mathematics and Sciences
- Business Studies
- Religious Education (CRE and IRE)
- Educational Assessment
- KCPE and KCSE Preparation
- High School Biology and Physics
- Social Studies and History
- Kenya Education System
- Digital Classroom Platform

## Getting Started

- [Primary School Online Learning](https://esomake.co.ke/primary): Primary school hub for CBC and 8-4-4 curriculum learning resources
- [Esoma-KE Classroom Help](https://esomake.co.ke/classroom/help): Getting started guide for Esoma-KE digital classroom platform

## Secondary School Mathematics

- [Form Four Revision Questions and Answers| Form Four Mathematics | Secondary School - EsomaKe](https://esomake.co.ke/secondary/mathematics/form-4/revision-questions): Form 4 Mathematics revision questions for exam preparation
- [Form 1 Mathematics Notes, Revision Questions and Answers | Secondary School - EsomaKe](https://esomake.co.ke/secondary/mathematics/form-1): Form 1 Mathematics notes covering integers, algebra, and more

## Secondary School Sciences

- [Force and Types of Forces | Mass vs Weight](https://esomake.co.ke/secondary/physics/force): Physics fundamentals: force types, friction, mass vs weight, vectors
- [Fluid Flow - Equation of continuity and Bernoulli's Principle](https://esomake.co.ke/secondary/physics/fluid-flow-form-two): Form 2 Physics: fluid flow, Bernoulli's Principle, equation of continuity
- [The Cell Structure| Form One | High School Biology](https://esomake.co.ke/secondary/biology/the-cell-structure-form-one): Form 1 Biology: cell organelles structure and functions
- [Estimation of Cell Size | Form One - High School Biology](https://esomake.co.ke/secondary/biology/the-cell-estimation-of-cell-size-form-one): Form 1 Biology: estimating cell size using light microscope

## Kiswahili and Language Studies

- [Fasihi Simulizi | Kiswahili Notes | Secondary School - Esoma-KE](https://esomake.co.ke/secondary/kiswahili/fasihi-simulizi/fasihi-simulizi): Oral literature (Fasihi Simulizi) notes for secondary Kiswahili
- [Ngeli za Kiswahili| Class 8 Kiswahili| Primary School - EsomaKe](https://esomake.co.ke/primary/class-8/kiswahili/ngeli-za-kiswahili): Class 8 Kiswahili grammar: noun classes (ngeli) with examples
- [Class 6 Kiswahili Revision Questions | Primary School - EsomaKe](https://esomake.co.ke/primary/class-6/kiswahili/revision-questions): Class 6 Kiswahili practice questions with answers for revision

## Business Studies and Commerce

- [Warehousing, Private, Public and Bonded Warehouse Notes | Form Two Business Studies | Secondary School - EsomaKe](https://esomake.co.ke/secondary/business-studies/warehousing-form-two): Form 2 Business Studies: warehousing types and storage management
- [Insurance Notes | Form Two Business Studies | Secondary School - Esoma-KE](https://esomake.co.ke/secondary/business-studies/insurance-form-two): Form 2 Business Studies: insurance principles and risk management

## Social Studies and History

- [Law, Peace and Conflict Resolution | Class 7 Social Studies | Primary School - Esoma-KE](https://esomake.co.ke/primary/class-7/social-studies/law-peace-and-conflict-resolution): Class 7 Social Studies: conflict resolution and human rights
- [Social Relations and Cultural Activities | Class 8 Social studies | Primary School - EsomaKe](https://esomake.co.ke/primary/class-8/social-studies/social-relations-and-cultural-activities): Class 8: traditional education, family structures, African marriages
- [Urbanization Notes | Form Two History | Secondary School - Esoma-KE](https://esomake.co.ke/secondary/history/urbanization-form-two): Form 2 History: urbanization in Africa (Cairo, Meroe, Kilwa, Egypt)

## Religious Education and Ethics

- [Form 4 Religious Education (CRE and IRE) Notes, Revision Questions and Answers | Secondary School](https://esomake.co.ke/secondary/religious-education/form-4): Form 4 CRE and IRE study materials covering Abraham, Moses, Sinai Covenant

## Early Learning and CBC

- [Next Number between 1 - 50 | Grade 1 | Kid Learning - EsomaKe](https://esomake.co.ke/kids-learning/next-number-grade-1): Grade 1 number sequence practice (1-50) for CBC curriculum
